ambiguities.text: The specification does not clearly define behavior when a node receives a Capella-typed light client message before it has itself transitioned to the Capella fork.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume nodes reject messages from future forks they haven't activated yet. Messages should be silently dropped or return an error response.

ambiguities.text: The chunking strategy for LightClientUpdatesByRange across fork boundaries is described at a high level without specifying exact boundary handling.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume updates are chunked by fork boundary, with each chunk containing only updates from a single fork version's SSZ type.

implicit_assumptions.description: Light client peers trust that the gossipsub finality and optimistic updates are produced by honest full nodes that have verified the underlying beacon chain data.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Malicious full nodes could broadcast fake finality updates, causing light clients to accept an incorrect chain view and potentially facilitating double-spend attacks.

implicit_assumptions.description: All peers in the network have upgraded to support Capella fork-specific SSZ types before the fork epoch.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Pre-Capella nodes would fail to deserialize Capella light client messages, causing network partitioning of the light client sync protocol.
